verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs are exposed as plain markdown files (e.g. graphql.md, webhooks.md, sdk.md, agents.md), which is exactly the pattern agent-oriented/llms.txt-style docs use so an agent can fetch clean text instead of scraping HTML. However, there is no explicit mention of an llms.txt file or a dedicated agent-facing docs index, so this is inferred rather than confirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit llms.txt manifest, and any statement that these .md docs are specifically packaged/discoverable for AI agents.
